lines.text: This is how you make your first vibe edit in under ten minutes. No timeline. No keyframes.
Step one. Put everything in one folder. Your clips, your music, your logo.
Step two. Open an AI agent in that folder, and write the brief. Platform, length, mood, and how it ends.
Step three. Let it build. It writes the edit as code, and renders a first draft.
Step four. Watch it once, and give three notes. Not fifty. Three.
Step five. Export, and keep the project. Next time, you only change the brief.
Want my brief template? Comment VIBE, and join vibe editing.
